title: PopSlinger
description:
🥤 ▼ POP THE BEAT, SAVE THE WORLD ▼PopSlinger is a vibrant, narrative-focused musical shooter inspired by the bold spirit of ‘80s and ‘90s New Retro culture.

Step into a world where style, rhythm, and soda-powered action collide in a neon-soaked adventure driven by music and heart.

💖 ▼ A HEROINE IS BORN ▼Join Ria Carbon, a funky heroine on a stylish quest to save the world from sinister invaders spilling in from another dimension. Armed with soda-powered guns and unstoppable groove, Ria takes the fight straight to the source of the corruption.

Backing her up is Gin, a former PopSlinger heroine whose experience — and attitude — prove crucial as the battle escalates.

Together, they face the Corazones: people whose hearts have been twisted and overtaken by dark forces from beyond reality.

🎨 ▼ STYLE, STORY & SODA COLLIDE▼🥤 Dreamy New Retro Visuals: Immerse yourself in an aesthetic inspired by 90’s Japanese animation, blending marker-style artwork with VHS-infused 2D sprites.

🎙️ Fully Voiced Cutscenes: Hand-drawn, vibrantly animated portraits bring the story to life through expressive, fully voiced dialogue scenes.

💫 Whimsical Narrative: Experience an emotional, stylish story inspired by classic magical girl anime, Japanese films, and television from the 90s — loaded with visual flair and special effects.

🔫 ▼ SODA-POWERED ACTION ▼Unleash a soft-drink-powered magical arsenal as you blast through waves of enemies in rhythm-driven combat.

Your performance shapes the experience: precision, timing, and flow all matter as you fight to reclaim corrupted hearts and restore harmony to the beat.

 

🎶 ▼ GROOVE TO THE RHYTHM ▼Every encounter moves to the music.

A fully dynamic soundtrack reacts to your in-game performance in real time, shifting and evolving as you shoot, dodge, and stay in sync. Inspired by an eclectic mix of genres — including Future Funk, New Jack Swing, and more — the soundtrack turns every battle into a living remix.

The better you play, the deeper the groove.

In PopSlinger, it’s not just about shooting! It's about doing it with Style and Strategy!

Use your Oranger to hit enemies with the matching color to keep the rhythm alive.

 
🎯 Land 4 shots of the same color to summon your Popping Powers! Each color brings Gin out to assist you!

🎨 Pop 8 enemies in two matching sets to create a Color Progression! — this makes the music change instantly!

Keep doing progressions to discover the whole track!!

🎨 8 of the same color leads to a Double Progression!!

The more combos you pull off, the more hype the music gets, and the higher rank you'll get! Get all you Rankmans!!

Complete specific combo sequences to unlock Dream Time! A hyper mode where Ria becomes invincible!! 

The best PopSlingers are smart and nimble! Their destinies are set during the party!!!

PopSlinger is a stylish, soda-powered musical adventure where rhythm fuels combat, emotion drives the story, and every shot pops to the beat.🥤 Developed by Funky Can Creative
description_short: Join a magical girl with a soda-powered arsenal on a dreamy quest to save her home! In this part beat-‘em-up, part musical shooter, you’ll experience the whimsical story of Ria and Gin as they fight against sinister invaders from another dimension…and maybe even groove to that funky beat!
